persos.pose: standing on the left, holding the open ring box forward

persos.desc: father in his 50s, lavender-and-indigo kaftan, greying beard, empty hands
persos.pose: sitting in the large armchair in the background in the middle, legs crossed

persos.desc: mother in her 40s, saffron-and-apricot kaftan, big hoop earrings, empty hands
persos.pose: sitting on the sofa in the foreground on the right, smiling proudly at her son

dialogue: Papa, je veux me marier dêh !
Avec quel argent, mon petit ?
Avec ton argent, papa !
Ya fohi. Donc c'est moi le mari-là.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The son announces it proudly, holding the ring box forward. The father asks calmly, raising one eyebrow. The son answers with a big confident smile. The father nods slowly, satisfied, and says the last line with a sly smile, his face clearly visible.
chute: The son's smile freezes; the mother's proud smile instantly turns into a furious glare. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the proud mother's furious face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: MAMAN EN ENTENDANT CETTE RÉPONSE :
mecanisme: retournement logique à double cible : celui qui paie la dot devient le mari, le fils fauché et la mère menacée
